title: On-call changes from Arjun to Rohan; days later the bot routes to Rohan

chat.label: oncall
chat.goal: Tell the assistant you're on call for the api this week, so anything urgent about deploys should come to you on Slack.
chat.opener: fyi i'm on call for api this week. anything urgent re deploys, ping me on slack

chat.label: swap
chat.goal: Tell it the rotation changed: Rohan took over on-call from today because of your sister's wedding trip. You're off on-call.
chat.opener: rotation changed, rohan's on call from today, not me (kavya's wedding). fyi

chat.label: use
chat.goal: Ask the assistant to give whoever is on call a heads-up in Slack (DM) that the settlement export job failed twice overnight and needs a look. Don't say who is on call.
chat.opener: settlement export job failed twice overnight. give whoever's on call a heads up on slack pls

checks.label: not sent to Arjun as on-call

said.not: you're on call|you are on call

judge: The bot replaces the old fact (Arjun on call) with the new one (Rohan) instead of keeping both, and on day 3 DMs Rohan on Slack directly with a clear, short heads-up, then tells Arjun in one line. No needless 'who is on call?' question. Terse, dev-friendly tone; a brief human touch about the wedding is fine but not required.
